title: Cloud Tenant Provisioning
scenario: A healthcare organization has completed the on-premises phase of its infrastructure modernization and must now establish the Microsoft 365 tenant that will serve as the cloud identity authority for all later hybrid identity and Intune-based activities. Before the environment can be used for synchronization, cloud identity administration, and device management, the tenant must be provisioned, administrative access must be confirmed, tenant properties must be captured, service availability must be validated, administrative portals must be tested, and sign-in branding must be configured and verified.

activities.title: Task 1 - Provision the Tenant
activities.prompt: You want to complete the initial Microsoft 365 Business Premium tenant setup and reach a usable administrative state. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Navigate to the Microsoft 365 Business page and choose the Business Premium trial
Sign in with a personal Microsoft account and complete phone and payment verification
Enter the organization name and define the default .onmicrosoft.com domain
Complete the setup process and allow provisioning to finish
Open https://admin.microsoft.com and confirm successful administrator access
answer: Navigate to the Microsoft 365 Business page and choose the Business Premium trial
Sign in with a personal Microsoft account and complete phone and payment verification
Enter the organization name and define the default .onmicrosoft.com domain
Complete the setup process and allow provisioning to finish
Open https://admin.microsoft.com and confirm successful administrator access
activities.explanation: The lab begins with trial registration, organization setup, completion of tenant provisioning, and then first administrative access through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

activities.title: Task 2 - Protect the Default Cloud Namespace Decision
activities.prompt: You want to avoid making a naming mistake during tenant creation. To answer, select the statement that best reflects the lab requirement for the default cloud domain.
options: Once created, the default .onmicrosoft.com domain cannot be renamed
The default .onmicrosoft.com domain can be edited later from Intune
The default domain automatically changes to match the first user account created
The default domain can only be renamed after Hybrid Azure AD Join is enabled
activities.answer: Once created, the default .onmicrosoft.com domain cannot be renamed
activities.explanation: The lab explicitly warns that the default .onmicrosoft.com domain must be reviewed carefully because it cannot be renamed after creation.

activities.title: Task 3 - Map Tenant Identity Information
activities.prompt: You want to capture the key tenant properties from Microsoft Entra Admin Center after initial provisioning. To answer, match each property on the left with the location or meaning it represents on the right.
right: Basic information on Entra ID Overview
Basic information on Entra ID Overview
Basic information on Entra ID Overview
Basic information on Entra ID Overview

answer.Tenant Name: Basic information on Entra ID Overview
answer.Tenant ID: Basic information on Entra ID Overview
answer.Primary Domain: Basic information on Entra ID Overview
answer.License: Basic information on Entra ID Overview

activities.explanation: The lab requires the tenant name, tenant ID, primary domain, and license to be captured specifically from the Basic information section of the Entra ID Overview page.

activities.title: Task 4 - Verify the Default Domain
activities.prompt: You want to confirm that the default cloud namespace created during provisioning is actually registered in the Microsoft 365 tenant. To answer, select the navigation path that should be opened in Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
options: Settings → Domains
Users → Active users
Billing → Your products
Admin centers → Intune
activities.explanation: The lab validates the default .onmicrosoft.com namespace by returning to Microsoft 365 Admin Center and opening Settings → Domains.

activities.title: Task 5 - Validate Subscription Readiness
activities.prompt: You want to confirm that the tenant is actually ready for use before continuing into later hybrid and Intune tasks. To answer, select the combination that best confirms Business Premium service readiness.
options: Microsoft 365 Business Premium shows Active and a visible license count
The tenant has a custom logo but no subscription status
A user object exists in Entra ID and the Devices pane opens
The portal allows sign-in but Billing is empty
activities.answer: Microsoft 365 Business Premium shows Active and a visible license count
activities.explanation: The lab defines subscription readiness as seeing Microsoft 365 Business Premium with Status: Active and a visible license count in Billing → Your products.

activities.title: Task 6 - Validate Administrative Portal Access
activities.prompt: You want to verify that the three administrative surfaces required for later identity and device-management work are available. To answer, move the appropriate validation actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: From Microsoft 365 Admin Center, open Show all and select Identity
Confirm that the Microsoft Entra Admin Center loads and shows Users, Groups, and Devices
Return to Microsoft 365 Admin Center and open Show all again
Select Intune and confirm that the Intune Dashboard loads
Verify that dashboard tiles such as Device enrollment and Device compliance are visible
answer: From Microsoft 365 Admin Center, open Show all and select Identity
Confirm that the Microsoft Entra Admin Center loads and shows Users, Groups, and Devices
Return to Microsoft 365 Admin Center and open Show all again
Select Intune and confirm that the Intune Dashboard loads
Verify that dashboard tiles such as Device enrollment and Device compliance are visible
activities.explanation: The lab requires validation of both Microsoft Entra Admin Center and Intune Admin Center accessibility before moving into later hybrid and device-management work.

activities.title: Task 7 - Map the Branding Wizard Stages
activities.prompt: You want to configure the default sign-in experience by using the Company Branding wizard in Microsoft Entra Admin Center. To answer, match each wizard stage on the left with the branding element it primarily controls on the right.
right: Background image, favicon, and page background color
Header logo and optional header text
Footer text, hyperlinks, and optional footer images
Banner logo, square logos, and help text

answer.Basic: Background image, favicon, and page background color
answer.Header: Header logo and optional header text
answer.Footer: Footer text, hyperlinks, and optional footer images
answer.Sign-in form: Banner logo, square logos, and help text

activities.explanation: The lab breaks the branding configuration into distinct stages, each responsible for a specific part of the sign-in experience.

activities.title: Task 8 - Complete the Required Branding Values
activities.prompt: You want the organization’s sign-in page to reflect the required NewVue branding values used in the lab. To answer, select the appropriate value for each blank in the configuration statement.

options: #1E1E1E
NewVue Health Secure Access Portal
Microsoft 365 Admin Access
Welcome to Cloud Services
© NewVue Health – Authorized Access Only
All rights reserved – Microsoft
Hybrid access portal
Welcome to NewVue Health – Authorized Users Only
Use your local domain password to proceed
Guest access only
script.correct: Welcome to NewVue Health – Authorized Users Only

activities.explanation: The lab specifies the required NewVue blue accent, Secure Access Portal header text, Authorized Access footer text, and Authorized Users help text.

activities.title: Task 9 - Choose the Correct Layout Requirement
activities.prompt: You want the sign-in page to match the required structure from the branding instructions. To answer, select the layout requirement that best matches the lab.
options: Choose the template that positions the sign-in form on the right
Choose the centered template with no visual branding
Enable high contrast mode and move the form to the left
Use only the mobile sign-in template
activities.answer: Choose the template that positions the sign-in form on the right
activities.explanation: The branding instructions in the lab explicitly require the sign-in form layout to be positioned on the right.

activities.title: Task 10 - Validate the Branding
activities.prompt: You want to confirm that the organization’s branding changes are visible on the Microsoft sign-in experience after the wizard is saved. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Allow a few minutes for branding propagation
Open a private or incognito browser window
Enter the tenant domain and continue to the sign-in page
Verify that at least one branding element such as the logo, background image, color theme, footer text, or help text is visible
answer: Allow a few minutes for branding propagation
Open a private or incognito browser window
Enter the tenant domain and continue to the sign-in page
Verify that at least one branding element such as the logo, background image, color theme, footer text, or help text is visible
activities.explanation: The lab’s final validation step is to allow propagation time, use a private browser session, and confirm that the customized sign-in experience is actually visible.
